purpose: PQ3.3b OpenFOAM campaign configured as a two-phase restoration policy: Phase 1 restores mean(rho_projection[active]) to the registered target 0.018 through uniform design-space ascent with per-iteration parent re-evaluation; Phase 2 maintains that projected volume while optimizing downforce with a volume-corrected objective backend.

evidence_retained_unmodified.reason: all three are kept unmodified as diagnostic evidence for the measured reachability history

evidence_interpretation_rule: the measured local infeasibility is 'the registered multiplicative OC family cannot bracket the registered target 0.018 inside a single step's move box for the recorded parent and gradient'. Multi-iteration monotone decay and permanent unreachability of the target across any backend family are NOT recorded claims; the multi-step risk is a risk, not a measured impossibility.

fixed_configuration.target_comparison_basis: projected basis only; raw design mean is not an infeasibility basis

phase_1_backend.B_direction: uniform design-space ascent on the joint active mask
phase_1_backend.bracket: kappa bisected so that phi(candidate) = 0.018 through DesignTransform.forward; monotonicity of sampled phi(kappa) asserted fail-closed at every evaluation
phase_1_backend.unreachable_policy: single-step frontier advance; acceptance requires the real primal, the projected-volume upper bound and the geometry gate
phase_1_backend.parent_refresh: per accepted step: parent primal (and gradient at Phase 2) from the accepted state, via OpenFoamOracle, with transform.pullback_from_beta before Phase 2 consumes the gradient

recipe: 1. downforce gradient produces the design proposal (descent-sign, full move step)
2. the candidate's projected volume is measured through DesignTransform.forward
3. a signed uniform offset (scalar kappa_volume) is applied and bisected to restore V_projection = 0.018 with residual <= 1e-4
4. the corrected candidate is judged only by the campaign loop (real primal + Path B bracket); Phase 2 acceptance requires measured downforce improvement, not volume repair alone
phase_2_backend.objective_ignored: Phase 1 only; Phase 2 always works from a freshly recomputed downforce gradient

campaign_start_conditions: preflight v3 passes (summary.preflight_pass == true) -- recorded as satisfied in preflight_v3_reference
mask drift is 0 at every accepted step (recorded)
the Phase 2 volume-corrected proposal lands on the target with residual <= 1e-4 at every level (recorded)
restoration brackets exist at b=4, b=8 and b=16 (recorded)
scripts/pq3_3b_campaign_2026_09.py does NOT silently fall back to the registered multiplicative OC backend (backend id asserted in the runner; the runner itself is not yet written)
the full test suite passes (recorded at commit time)
still_missing_before_campaign: scripts/pq3_3b_campaign_2026_09.py runner with explicit backend-id assertion against project-volume-restoration-oc and volume-corrected-objective-oc
explicit user go/no-go on campaign start
acceptance_gates_during_campaign: Phase 2 acceptance requires measured downforce improvement of the corrected candidate over the fresh parent state
final state: discreteness in rho_projection (mean_nd <= 0.01, max_rho >= 0.9) plus the stage_s_entry composite ready_for_stage_s verdict, both recorded as artifacts
no raw-design-mean argument may be used to declare the campaign infeasible
next_step_owner: user go/no-go on starting the campaign after this manifest is committed
